ابتذلن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَذَلْنَ (ibtaḏalna) /ib.ta.ðal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اُبْتُذِلْنَ (ubtuḏilna) /ub.tu.ðil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# اِبْتَذِلْنَ (ibtaḏilna) /ib.ta.ðil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
